dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior, terminating in a rounded point at the image margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-gray to off-white median pixel intensity, filtering for the ambient water tint.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, diffuse dark-pixel patches distributed across the mid-dorsal and posterior surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the lighter baseline and the faint, pigmented mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple fine, high-contrast white linear marks (scratches or rake marks) on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear surface scratches/rake marks visible on the mid-dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, dark elliptical blowhole orifice on the anterior dorsal surface.
